assets.caption: Fig. C-2 Fundamental Natural Frequencies of Common Piping Spans (2 of 2)
assets.notes: Full-page figure containing two piping span configurations with natural frequency formulas (fn = 705·C·k/L1^2) and accompanying notes. Upper span shows two-span configuration with formula for C* involving L2/L1, L3/L1, L4/L1, P/(wL1) terms. Lower span shows similar configuration with extended formula. Notes column describes: (1) frequency formula applicability for in-plane vibration, empty carbon steel pipe; (2) corrections for stainless steel and water in pipe from Sheet 1 of 2; (3) piping configurations for metering pump service.
